## Notes

Raspberry Pi Pico W (RP2040, Cortex-M0+, 264 KiB SRAM) on Zephyr 3.7, serial only. Its Wokwi twin boots the C talker over UART0 (the Wokwi serial monitor), with the console on UART1. The image needs `CONFIG_TICKLESS_KERNEL=n` (in the board's prj.conf) and five RAM knobs, which are the descriptor's `[knobs]` and every image inherits. Each twin run needs your own `WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN` and spends that account's simulation minutes, so the twin is run by users and not in nano-ros CI.

See [Board Support Levels](../board-support-levels.md) for what each status means.
